name: vessel_class
domain: categorical: {Bulk Carrier, Container Ship, Fish Carrier, Tanker}
justification: Real ship-type categories observed in ship_performance.csv with real speed/draft/cargo stats per class.

name: route
domain: categorical: real port-pair rows of route_derived.csv
justification: Real port coordinates (fig2_port_coordinates.csv) with haversine-derived distance/voyage time.

name: speed_knots
domain: continuous/grid, bounded by [speed_min_kn, speed_max_kn] of the chosen vessel_class
justification: Observed min/max speed per ship type from ship_performance.csv are real operating bounds.

name: fuel_type
justification: The two fuel families actually observed/engineered as model inputs in the trained XGB pipeline.

name: cargo_tons
data_source: fleet_parameters.csv (DERIVED capacity) + cargo_demand_derived.csv (real Indian port aggregate demand as a reference target)
justification: Capacity per vessel class is DERIVED from two real means (see data_layer.py); route-level cargo assignment target is SCENARIO_INPUT because no real OD (origin-destination) tonnage exists for the specific synthetic route pairs.

name: vessel_activation
symbol: Not modelled as a separate binary in this leg-based prototype; implicit in per-leg vessel_class choice. See module docstring.

name: shore_power
symbol: No real/derived shore-power or cold-ironing data exists anywhere in the data layer; would require an invented number. EXCLUDED.
